stories.h: Man freed hours earlier charged in deadly Everett shooting
stories.s: A 40-year-old Lynnwood man faces first-degree murder and other charges in an Oct. 26 south Everett robbery-shooting that killed one brother and wounded another, less than 12 hours after his release from state custody.

stories.h: Everett proposes $7M fund to curb south Everett displacement
stories.s: The city and partners plan a fund to protect renters and small businesses ahead of light rail, with $5M from the city and $2M to be raised by LISC Puget Sound.

stories.h: Arrest in Marysville yard-waste-bin body case
stories.s: A 49-year-old Marysville man faces misdemeanor charges of concealing a body and unlawfully disposing of remains in the April death of Sarah Arneklev; police say he told them she collapsed after using fentanyl.

stories.h: Snohomish PUD launches Peak Assist bill-credit program
stories.s: Residential customers can enroll via MySnoPUD to cut use during short high-demand events starting Jan. 1, earning a $25 credit after the first survey plus prize drawings.

coming.s: Holiday kickoff runs 2-8 p.m. at Colby and Hewitt avenues, with Santa lighting the tree just after 5 p.m.
